channel.title: Careshots
channel.description:
Your daily dose of healthcare news: 3 to 5 of the biggest stories in biotech, pharma, and health policy in about 15 minutes, tboy-style. Hosted by Alex and Jordan.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 35: GSK's Lung-Cancer Win, a Rare-Disease First, and Medicare's $2.5B Save
item.description: Alex and Jordan on GSK's FDA win for Nelkarmi in ALK-positive lung cancer, Beren's first survival-extending therapy for Niemann-Pick type C, and Medicare's record $2.5B in shared-savings savings.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 34: Roche's Breast-Cancer Win, Teva's At-Home First, CMS's $90B Fraud Crackdown
item.description: Alex and Jordan on Roche's FDA win for Wilserdly in ESR1-mutated breast cancer, Teva's first at-home agitation treatment IGALMI, and CMS's $90B CRUSH fraud crackdown.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 33: Viking's 74% BMI Win, Amylyx's 55% Win, Medicare's Early Leaders
item.description: Alex and Jordan on Viking's VK2735 BMI-category win at ObesityWeek, Amylyx's avexitide Phase 3 win in post-bariatric hypoglycaemia, and Humana and UnitedHealthcare's early lead in Medicare Advantage enrolment.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 32: Klygefa's Weekly Win, Compass's Psilocybin Timeline, Ardent's Hospital Rebound
item.description: Alex and Jordan on AstraZeneca's weekly at-home Klygefa shot for myasthenia gravis, Compass Pathways putting a revenue date on its psilocybin therapy, and Ardent Health's 51% hospital-margin rebound.

item.title: Careshots — Bonus: FDA's Fast Lane Shelved, R1's Revenue-Cycle Bet
item.description: Alex and Jordan on the FDA's fast-lane voucher pilot going quiet, R1's revenue-cycle operating system passing $275B in patient revenue, and Blackstone's $1.5B bet on Pfizer's monthly GLP-1.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 31: Imfinzi's Bladder Win, Gazyva's Kidney First, Psychedelics Go Federal
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down AstraZeneca's Imfinzi-plus-Padcev approval in muscle-invasive bladder cancer, Roche's Gazyva becoming the first drug ever approved for primary membranous nephropathy, and HHS putting federal money behind ibogaine and psychedelic research. Plus a lightning round: Windward Bio's IPO, BJC Health's St. Louis hospital grab, and the US measles elimination milestone.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 30: Abbott's Heart Lead, Aravax's Peanut Win, Payers' Q3 Rebound
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Abbott's UltiSynq defibrillation lead winning FDA approval and a CE mark, Aravax's once-monthly peanut allergy shot posting strong Phase 2 results in kids, and the big payers' Q3 rebound — built on shedding members while hospitals absorb the fallout. Plus a lightning round: NervGen's Breakthrough Therapy designation for spinal cord injury.

item.title: Careshots — Episode 29: Oura's $625M Care Bet, Amgen's Sjögren's First, Lilly's PsA Combo
item.description: Alex and Jordan break down Oura's $625M acquisition of Counsel Health to turn its ring into a doctor's office, Amgen's first-ever Phase 3 win in Sjögren's disease, and Lilly stacking Taltz and Zepbound in psoriatic arthritis. Plus a lightning round: Inovio's DNA immunotherapy approval and Freenome's big quarter.
